access_links.label: First dataset of the collection on the European data portal

description: Parking Brussels: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Parking Brussels. Coverage: Parking Brussels. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Offre de stationnement vélo sécurisé en Région de Bruxelles Capitale; Dispositifs de stationnement modes alternatifs 2024; Offre de stationnement hors voirie; Demande de stationnement en voirie 2019. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
